text:
leo: hi folks, first day! i tried to open the staging console to poke at feature flags and got redirected to an SSO page then a 403. can someone point me to the minimal access i need for local dev checks? also our e2e CI needs to flip a feature 'onboarding_flow_v2' temporarily. who to ask for a short-lived SA vs if we should use a runbook-based flip?

anika: welcome leo :tada: the usual for local dev is `console-read` + `staging-ff-view`. that lets you see flag owners and eval history. if you need to toggle flags locally for experiments, we prefer using a local feature-flag mock instead of toggling staging production flags. docs: https://intranet.redwood/dev/onboarding/flags (see "local dev" subsection).

leo: i only need visibility for now. want to check rollout history before opening a PR.

devops: quick checklist: 1) confirm your SSO email matches your org account; 2) check group sync (some AD groups take ~10-15m); 3) if still 403, post a screenshot and i'll run a lookup. we have two SA paths: ephemeral tokens (recommended) or a short-lived service account with 7-day TTL for integration tests. which CI runner are you on?

leo: running GH Actions on the repo `redwood/onboard`. ephemeral tokens sound ideal. how to request?

infra-bot: Access request created: TICKET-4481. Requester: leo. Requested roles: console-read, staging-ff-view. Request status: pending. Estimated action time: 1 business hour.

anika: for GH Actions we issue short-lived OAuth tokens via the token-service. add a comment to TICKET-4481 with repo path and workflow file path, and we can whitelist the workflow and give you a `workflow-token` with 6h TTL. for longer CI needs we go SA route.

leo: screenshot attached. says "Access denied: insufficient role" after SSO.

devops: looked up your account — you're in `new-joiners` but not `staging-developers`. i added a temporary `staging-ff-view` grant for 2 hours so you can inspect owners and rollout. logout/login to refresh.

ops-jen: fyi product-lee owns `onboarding_flow_v2`. if you need a flip for e2e, file a feature-change PR with the test tag and cc product-lee + qa. we do guarded flips for tests (short window, auto-revert).

leo: can confirm i can see flags now, owner is product-lee. i've added a comment to TICKET-4481 with repo and workflow. thanks everyone!

anika: great — we'll follow up in the ticket with the workflow-token credentials and a link to the runbook for guarded flips. welcome again, shout if anything else blocks you.

leo: thanks all, saved my afternoon :)
